tool.name: CpG Harmonisation Stage 2: Cross-Platform Quantile Normalisation
tool.description: Type I/II-aware beta quantile normalisation across 450K and EPIC (wateRmelon::betaqn)

configfiles.configfile:
require('minfi', quietly = TRUE) require('wateRmelon', quietly = TRUE) options(warn = -1)
load('$grset_in') if (!exists('GRSet')) { stop("grset_in .rda must contain an object named 'GRSet'") }
betas <- getBeta(GRSet) betas.norm <- betaqn(betas) #wateRmelon::betaqn - Type I/II aware quantile normalisation, aligns beta distributions across 450K and EPIC
assay(GRSet, 'Beta') <- betas.norm
pca <- prcomp(t(na.omit(betas.norm))) summary.pca <- summary(pca)\$importance write.table(summary.pca, file = '$summarytab', quote = FALSE, sep = '\t', col.names = NA)
png('$pcapng') plot(pca\$x[,1], pca\$x[,2], xlab = 'PC1', ylab = 'PC2', main = 'Post-normalisation PCA (betaqn)', pch = 19) dev.off()
save(GRSet, file = '$grset_out')

param.name: grset_in
param.label: Stage 1 GenomicRatioSet
param.help: Must contain an object named GRSet - the Stage 1 (Noob background correction) output.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Stage 2 of the cross-array (450K/EPIC) harmonisation pipeline. Takes the Noob-corrected ``GenomicRatioSet`` from Stage 1 and applies ``wateRmelon::betaqn``, a Type I/II probe-design-aware quantile normalisation of beta values. This aligns beta value distributions across samples run on different array platforms (450K and EPIC), which is necessary before combining them for downstream batch correction and analysis.
***Inputs***
*Stage 1 GenomicRatioSet*: ``.rda`` output of the Noob background correction stage.
***Outputs***
*Stage 2 GenomicRatioSet*: an ``.rda`` file containing the normalised ``GRSet``, consumed by Stage 3 (ComBat batch correction).
*PCA Plot and Summary*: principal component analysis of the normalised beta matrix, useful for visually confirming that samples no longer separate by array platform after normalisation.
